NISHITA MHETRE +917900089695 | nishumhetre7@gmail.com

WORK EXPERIENCE

Analyst, Capgemini Dec 2023 – Present

Profile - SAP EWM, SAP MM, WM(Basics)

Have experience on SAP EWM is S4 system as well as ECC System

Completed end-to-end business process like inbound delivery, outbound delivery, STP, along with idoc testing.

Made documentations for scenarios for run team.

Used RFUI for internal warehouse processes

Monitoring the processes and materials in warehouse in /scwm/mon

Good Functional knowledge on setting up Master Data in the EWM System i.e., Number Ranges, Storage Types, Storage Bin Types, Storage Areas, Work Centres, Activity Areas, Define and Assign warehouse numbers, Packaging Specifications etc.

Configuration knowledge on Storage type, Availability group, Stock types, WP type, WOCR, Configured wave

types, category, and wave capacity profile and wave template configurations.

Worked on INCIDENTS and TASKS which were allotted on ServiceNow

Worked on ECC and EWM stuck queues on both ECC and EWM systems

Responsible for providing KT’s to client and prepared KEBD documents for it (For WM based deliveries)

Responsible for queue handling in both ECC (EWM related queues) and EWM systems

Data load activities in testing, quality and production systems along with their verification.

Industrial Intern- Process Precision Instruments

Jun 2022 – Jul 2022

Applied Arduino programming skills to develop and implement project-based solutions, leveraging industrial

expertise

Engaged in hands-on training focusing on industrial applications, honing skills through the creation of projects

within an industrial environment

In-house Intern- Autobot Dynamics

Jul 2021 – Oct 2021

Engineered a smartwatch prototype addressing women's safety concerns by integrating Sim800l and Arduino,

enabling distress messaging to family and registered police stations with location coordinates

Applied Arduino programming expertise to design a functional device, facilitating alert messages during

emergencies with a single push button.

PROJECTS

BREWIT

Engineered and implemented a user-friendly vending machine capable of providing personalized coffee based on

face recognition technology.

• Employed HOG and SVM algorithms within Python for facial recognition, ensuring precise and accurate user

identification.

Wrote a paper on this project, which has a published patent in the Indian Patent Portal (Application No: 202321055798 A)

EDUCATION

Vidyalankar Institute of Technology 2019 – 2023

Bachelor of Technology in Electronics Engineering

CGPA: 8.76

EXTRACURRICULARS

Oversaw the entire hackathon, effectively coordinating participant groups and addressing their queries to ensure a

smooth event.

Organized and conducted two educational webinars within the college premises

Facilitated the successful hosting of an international paper conference held at the college

Actively served as a member of the sports council, efficiently managing and overseeing three sporting events

Attained selection within the top 10 teams during the initial round of the Smart India Hackathon, showcasing

innovative problem-solving abilities.

SKILLS

ICT: SAP EWM, SAP MM, WM(Basics), C/C++, HTML, SQL, Python Basics, Java Basics. Languages: English, Hindi Certifications: SAP EWM- Extended Warehouse management- (Udemy), SAP EWM- Fundamentals of EWM(Udemy), SAP MM- Materials management full course (Udemy), SAP CPI- Overview of SAP CPI(Udemy), SAP S/4 EWM(Udemy), Gen AI(coursera)
